newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: TENNIS-Sydney to host Davis Cup tie against France.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-Sydney to host Davis Cup tie against France.

text.p: Sydney will host the Davis Cup tie against France on grass next February after beating bids by Adelaide, Perth, and Townsville, Tennis Australia said on Monday.
The World Group first round tie between February 7-9 will be played at White City, a venue favoured by Davis Cup captain John Newcombe.
"White City is where I grew up playing tennis -- I have a soft spot for it," Newcombe said in a statement released by Tennis Australia.
"The boys are all extremely excited about playing at home," Newcombe said.
"They know it is going to be a tough match but they are determined to show the Australian sporting fraternity that they have what it takes to win the Davis Cup."
